transcriber_notes: Measured on the embedded 6160x2832 chart raster. Boundaries printed on the right axis (bent leaders at 69/49/35/26 are label offsets only). Hardness bar ends fall exactly on class gridlines. Temperatures are vertices of a continuous polyline without point markers (Douglas-Peucker on the traced line), 0 C taken at the bar edge (x calibrated with the air-temperature dashes: -12.0 printed, -12.1 read), +-0.2 C; the dashed air-temperature segment is vertical, so surface = air temperature. Densities are printed at measurement heights (71, 60, 40, 30, 20, 5 cm) and assigned to the containing layer. Red highlight lines drawn at 69 and 49 cm.
